name: tiltx
description: TiltX — turn an Android phone into a real-time motion controller for a browser racing game

scripts.dev: npm run prepare:shared && concurrently -k -n server,game,controller -c magenta,cyan,green "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:game" "npm:dev:controller"
scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run prepare:shared && npm run build -w @tiltx/server && npm run build -w @tiltx/game && npm run build -w @tiltx/controller
scripts.build:game: npm run prepare:shared && npm run build -w @tiltx/game
scripts.build:controller: npm run prepare:shared && npm run build -w @tiltx/controller
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:controller && node scripts/ensure-android.mjs && npm run -w @tiltx/controller cap:sync
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd apps/controller/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
